title: $100 a month into Visa since 2008 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Visa since 2008.
Today that would be worth about {dca:V:2008-03-19} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Visa price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Visa, starting in 2008.
Back then, Visa was listing in a crisis.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:V:2008-03-19}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
